Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling northbound in the left lane approaching the signalized intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, when
the vehicle was struck on the driver's side by Driver 2, whose vehicle was southbound and entered the intersection as
the light changed. The point of impact on both vehicles is consistent with a right-angle collision of this type. Driver 1
reported pain in the right shoulder at the scene and was evaluated by responding medics, whose observations align
with the force of a side impact of this kind. Passenger was seated in the vehicle at the time of the collision and was
also present for the statements taken at the scene. Driver 1 stated that no prior damage had occurred to the vehicle.
Scene photographs taken by the officer show damage to the driver's side panels and door, which matches the
account given by both drivers. No independent witnesses were located at the intersection, and no traffic camera
footage was available at the time of this report. Driver 1 provided a copy of the insurance policy, under which Driver 1
is the named insured. Both drivers were cited for further review, and the matter has been referred for follow-up.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- occupants_listed: How many people does the police report list in the insured vehicle (Vehicle 1)? The rating is a whole number. Allowed: a whole number.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.
